999008199.text:
たくさんいて、キリがない……！
果ての大陸まで、あとどれくらい！？

localizations.en: There are so many of them, they just keep coming...! How much further to World's End?!

999008199.text:
黄金星があそこで、あの星があそこだから……
あと少しのはず！　もうちょっと、次さえ越えれば！

localizations.en: The golden star is there, and that star is there, so... we should be close! Just a little more—if we can get past the next wave!

999008199.text: だが、次は……
出たな、大物たち……

localizations.en: There they are. The big ones...

999008199.text:
前に撤退を余儀なくされた、
あの大型魔物たちの群れ……

localizations.en: That pack of large monsters... the same ones that forced us to retreat before...

999008199.text: 大丈夫か？　アルビーナの嬢ちゃん

姉様なら、大丈夫。
私たちだって、ついてる……ね？

localizations.en: She's fine. And we've got her back... right?

999008199.text:
うん。正直言うとめっちゃ怖い。
見た瞬間、嫌な汗が全身から噴き出てきたけど

localizations.en: Yeah. Honestly? I'm terrified. The second I saw them, I broke out in a cold sweat all over.

999008199.text:
でも、もう逃げない。前回とは違う。
身体も、技も、錬金術も鍛えてきたんだから

localizations.en: But I'm not running this time. It's different from before. I've trained my body, my skills, my alchemy—all of it.

999008199.text:
ここでまた逃げて、みんなを……
自分自身を裏切るほうが怖い！

localizations.en: Running away again and betraying everyone... betraying myself—that scares me a whole lot more!

999008199.text:
なるほど……鍛えた成果が出たみたいだね。
本人は知ってか知らずか、言わないでいるが

localizations.en: Heh... looks like all that training paid off. Though she doesn't seem to realize it herself.

999008199.text:
ええ、あの子が一番成長したのは、心です。
とっても立派に、ね

localizations.en: She's grown more than anyone. And it's here—right here in her heart. I couldn't be prouder.

999008199.text:
ふぅ……よし！　やってやる！
アレ使うよ！　ベップ！

localizations.en: Okay... here we go! Let's do this! Time to use that thing—you ready, Bepp?!

999008199.text: 準備できてるわ、姉様！

それってもしかしなくても、持ち物整理の時に
陽動に使うって言ってたやつだね？

localizations.en: That wouldn't happen to be the decoy you mentioned during the supply check, would it?

999008199.text:
うん。アタシは案内人として、責任を持って
みんなを目的地まで案内するんだから！

localizations.en: You bet. I'm a Star Guide—and it's my job to get everyone to their destination safely!

999008199.text:
これを使って魔物を遠くに陽動し、その隙に
煙幕に隠れながら進む……危険は少なくしたいものね

localizations.en: We'll use it to lure the monsters away, then slip through under cover of smoke. Better to minimize the risk where we can.

999008199.text:
それでも船に張り付いてくる魔物はいるだろうから、
そこは私たちの出番だね

localizations.en: Some will still latch onto the hull even so. That's where the rest of us come in.

999008199.text:
うん。大変だけど、あとちょっとなんだ……
みんな、行くよ！！

localizations.en: Right. It won't be easy, but we're so close now... Everyone, let's move!!

999008199.text: 絶対たどり着いてやる、果ての大陸……！

localizations.en: We are going to make it to World's End—no matter what...!
